title: "[Hardware donation] short description of the hardware"

Thank you for offering hardware! Donated hardware is used to test and validate
arc-rebar on more GPUs and platforms. **Graphics cards** (any Intel Arc model) and
**motherboards** (especially boards without a Resizable BAR option, server boards
and dual-GPU boards) help most; complete systems and other hardware are welcome too.
We consider every offer, but storage space is limited, so please don't ship
anything until we've confirmed.

**Please describe the hardware only.** Do not post your name, address, phone
number, email or any other personal details in this issue; it is public.

**To arrange shipping and other details privately**, email
**burlam1nx@outlook.com** and include this issue's number.

## What you're offering

- Type (graphics card / motherboard / complete system / other):
- Make and model:
- Condition (working / partially working / untested):
- Anything known about it (for example: no Resizable BAR option in BIOS, server board, dual-GPU capable):

## Logistics

- Country or region only (for shipping feasibility):
- Anything we should know about shipping (size, weight):

Donating hardware does not create any support obligation or change the
project's licensing terms. With your permission, we'll thank you in the
README's Supporters list.
